text:
Anya: Heads up — I'm opening a PR to consolidate a few console examples around the cost/latency heatmap + tracehook stitching. Need owners for SDK snippets (Node/Rust) and a short migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12468
DocsBot: docs-bot: PR opened by Anya. CI checks queued.
Sam: I'll take Node + a quick example for batch prefetch. Will add unit tests.
Mike: Noted. I spotted a mismatch in cost-attribution labels when tracehook metadata is missing; we should add fallback logic in the snippet.
Rafa: @Sam can you include the case where trace key arrives base64-encoded? We've had a few consumers break on that.
Kelsey: I can draft the migration blurb + a one-liner for Dedicated customers about behavioral changes.
Anya: Thanks — aiming to merge by Friday EOD. Sam/Mike please add review tags and call out any UX impact.
Sam: Working on it now. Draft Node snippet: 
```js
// attach a base64 trace key to outbound request
const traceKey = Buffer.from('request-id-123').toString('base64');
await client.generate({ input, trace: { trace_key: traceKey } });
```
Anything else to cover?
Mike: Add an explicit fallback note: if `trace_key` missing, reconcile using span_id header. Also record that heatmap buckets changed 10->12 in v2; mapping hint: `mapped = floor(old_bucket * 1.2)`.
Rafa: For Rust I'll port the Node example and show serde decode: 
```rust
let trace_key_b64 = "...";
let trace_key = base64::decode(trace_key_b64)?;
// attach into telemetry struct
```
Also adding an example for function-calls telemetry.
Anya: Link fix item — a couple of older examples still point to /examples/heatmap (deprecated). @DocsBot can you run link-check after CI?
DocsBot: docs-bot: link-check started. 12 pages scanned, 2 redirects found.
Kelsey: I'll own the redirect PR once this lands.
Sam: PR updated with Node + Python snippets. PTAL @Mike @Rafa
Mike: Left a small nit about log level and suggested a tiny unit test for the mapping logic.
Rafa: LGTM on the Rust port. I'll open a companion PR in examples-repo for the live sample.
Anya: Great. Merge plan if CI & link-check green: squash+merge, then create a backport to main-legacy branch with a shim snippet for older clients.
DocsBot: docs-bot: CI passed :white_check_mark:. link-check: 0 failures.
Kelsey: Scheduling merge for Fri 10:00am PT. I'll post a heads-up in #release-war-room before merging.
Sam: Thanks all — I'll address Mike's nit and ping for final review later today.
Anya: Appreciate it — will follow up on the rollout notes and telemetry dashboards once merged.
